blocks.text: Stack mein do basic (bunyadi) operations hote hain:

items: Push: stack ke top par item dalna. Python mein stack banane ke liye list istemal hoti hai, is liye list ka append() function top par item dalta hai.
Pop: stack ke top wala item nikalna. Is ke liye list ka pop() function istemal hota hai.

blocks.text: Misal: Figure 4.2 jaisa mez par kitabon ka dher sochiye. Aap sirf sab se oopar kitab rakh sakte hain ya sab se oopar wali kitab utha sakte hain. Neeche isi kitabon ke stack ka Python code hai.

# Create an empty stack of books
stack_of_books = []
print("Initial stack:", stack_of_books)          # Empty stack
# Add books to the stack (push operation)
print("\n Adding books to the stack (push operation):")
stack_of_books.append('Book A')
print("Stack after pushing 'Book A':", stack_of_books)
stack_of_books.append('Book B')
print("Stack after pushing 'Book B':", stack_of_books)
stack_of_books.append('Book C')
print("Stack after pushing 'Book C':", stack_of_books)
# Remove the top book from the stack (pop operation)
print("\nDeletion of top book (pop operation):")
top_book = stack_of_books.pop()
print("Removed book:", top_book)
print("Stack after popping the top book:", stack_of_books)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke code mein do ghaltiyan hain: (1) pehli line mein stack_of_books = [] comment ke saath hi likha hai, is liye list banti hi nahi aur NameError aata hai; upar ise alag line par likha gaya hai. (2) append(’Book A’) waghaira mein tirchhe quotes ’ hain, jinhein Python nahi maanta (SyntaxError); sahi append('Book A') hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar stack dabbe: pehle mein Book A, doosre mein Book A aur B, teesre mein Book A, B aur C (har baar oopar se push yani append), aur chauthe mein pop() ke baad Book A aur B, jab ke Book C oopar se bahar nikal gayi.
blocks.caption: Stack mein push (append) aur pop: aakhir mein dali Book C sab se pehle nikalti hai (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.text: Code pehle kitabon ke liye khali stack banata hai. Phir teen kitabein ("Book A", "Book B" aur "Book C") ek ek kar ke top par dalta hai. Aakhir mein top wali kitab "Book C" nikalta hai. Is se pata chalta hai ke jo kitab aakhir mein rakhi gayi, wohi pehle nikli.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Stacks depth-first search (DFS) jaise algorithms mein bhi istemal hote hain, jo graph ko traverse (har node par ja kar dekhna) karte hain. Stack aage dekhne wale nodes ko LIFO order mein sambhalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Stack ke top se item kaunsa operation nikalta hai (MCQ 3)?

items: A, B, C push kar ke pop karein to C nikalta hai (LIFO).
